Prepares output for HDX-MS Undeuterated sample data.

Source: R/output_UD_FD.R
output_UD.Rd

Returns the in-exchange control (Deut.Time 0, e.g. "0s" or "0.00s"): one row per peptide and protein state, one column per replicate (uptake in Da). Missing uptake (HDXExaminer writes n/a for the undeuterated sample) is set to 0, since the undeuterated sample is the reference.

Usage

output_UD(filepath)

Arguments

filepath

filepath to the input file. Input file is All_results table from HDX_Examiner, where all the fields are marked for export. Can also be a DynamX cluster/state export, or a table from read_hdx() / as_hdx_long().

Value

data frame with reorganized data where in columns is uptake data for Protein States.

Examples

file_nm<-system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
a<- output_UD(file_nm)
